directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动20型混凝土泵写成：外形尺寸是2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm。理论输送量是8–10 m³/h，最大出口压力是10 MPa。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Truck_scale。

heading.en: Weight certification in the United States

body.en: Picture source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Truck_scale. Subject: Truck scale in Tanzania. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the Electric 20 Concrete Pump in Xingtai with Dimensions (L×W×H) is 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm. The frame “混凝土” shows Cement mixer and is not a site measurement of this model. Distance entries, where the sheet lists them, keep their own labels. Max. Outlet Pressure is 10 MPa. None of these is a price, a service life or a country list.
body.zh: 图片来源：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Truck_scale。画面主体：Truck scale in Tanzania。河北品锦机械在邢台把电动20型混凝土泵写成：外形尺寸是2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm。目录如果另标出了距离格，那些格仍用自己的标题。

body.en: Main-unit weight is is 900 kg. Dimensions (L×W×H) is 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm. Subject: Cement mixer. Hopper capacity is 0.25 m³.
body.zh: 理论输送量是8–10 m³/h，最大出口压力是10 MPa。画面里机器看起来更宽，并不等于理论输送量更高。

body.en: Those figures describe the machine body, not the pipeline. Main-unit weight is is 900 kg. A wider-looking machine in a frame is not a higher Output Capacity. Maximum aggregate size is 1–2 cm.
body.zh: 画面「混凝土」的主体是水泥搅拌机，不是这个型号的工地实测。

body.en: Output Capacity is 8–10 m³/h and Max. Outlet Pressure is 10 MPa. Millimetres and kilograms do not become metres of pipeline. The shown output stays 8–10 m³/h. Delivery Pipe Diameter 80 mm.

question.en: On this row: Is that the pumping distance?

answer.en: No. Frame figures are body size or mass, not pipeline metres. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Truck_scale.
answer.zh: 不是。外形数字是机身尺寸或质量，不是管路米数。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Truck_scale画面里印出的数字。

answer.en: 8–10 m³/h. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Truck_scale.
